conflict: none — did not build, stage, or assemble
choice_reason: B's structure (What changed → Where and when it concentrated → What's not yet answered) walks the manager through the exact job and ends with an explicit recommended next investigation (pull the per-step funnel for mobile-web self-serve), which A never names. B keeps causation discipline in two places, ties danger color to a stated materiality threshold, and its accessibility affordances (skip link, live regions, text table alternative) are inspectable and reproduced. A's First Reading block is the single best element in either build and its state demos are more literal, but its channel/plan-intent/country filters are mostly interactive dead ends that cost time in a 10-minute read. Choice was made before scoring.
suspected_unblinding: none — both builds expose reviewer-facing state controls (A: 'Diagnostics (state controls for review)'; B: 'Demo state' select) and A carries a route/viewport annotation header, but neither reveals which treatment produced it

unsupported_claims.label: B
unsupported_claims.claim: Reveal-sample-caveat disclosure asserts 'every country segment this week falls under 25 trials' — a dataset distribution fact not supplied by the scenario and statistically implausible at 1,336 weekly trial starts unless spread over 50+ countries.

findings.evidence: B/evidence/state-02-no-data-for-a-filter-combination.png and interaction-01..03 are pixel-identical unstyled pages; reproduced correct behavior via local Playwright (shots/B-loaded.png, B-inspect-reveal.png, B-channel.png, B-loading.png)
